newsitem.title: HONG KONG: HK stock exchange to boost turnover capacity.
newsitem.headline: HK stock exchange to boost turnover capacity.

text.p: The Stock Exchange of Hong Kong said on Thursday it would upgrade its transaction capacity following a recent surge in turnover to record levels.
"This week we will enhance our system capacity from HK$20 billion to HK$24 to HK$28 billion and then next week we will be able to increase that to HK$32 billion," a spokesman said.
"I think we have to prepare for increases in turnover. We have seen turnover increase from HK$10 billion to an average of over HK$15 billion (per day) in the last couple of weeks."
Turnover hit a record HK$18.04 billion on Monday and Wednesday's was the third heaviest ever at HK$17.70 billion.
The rise in turnover has accompanied the Hang Seng Index's drive to all-time highs over recent sessions.
The blue chip index surged 247.12 points, or 1.78 percent, to close at a record high of 14,153.58 on Wednesday.

The Exchange spokesman said the rise in turnover to HK$17-18 billion brought the number of transactions to near 160,000 per day. "We can handle over 200,000 transaction so we still have some spare capacity there but we have to prepare for the future and that is why we are upgrading," the spokesman said.
He said the first upgrade in hardware would take place this weekend.
